source.title: Valor Grows by Daring
source.objective: Collect Remnants of Valor within Naxxramas.
source.progress:
Your seal has a long way to go if you mean to see it reach its potential. Bring me more Remnants of Valor, and I'll continue to provide you with the strength to protect our world.

Remember, hero, that the dead cannot cry out for justice. It is the duty of the living to do so for them.
source.completion: Well done. As before, this will only take a moment.
